summary._about: Experiment 33. HG = experiment 25's heading-held-out gain (guard45), read from the same readouts on a test subset of rows. Primary: the view's image-end token, single-query prompt with the ordered walk, novel views, layer 35, runs 3-7, for MLP neurons and the residual stream separately. Calls: positive >= 0.5, partial 0.25-0.5, negative < 0.25, no position code if the seen-heading readout beats chance by < 0.5 m. Differences are A minus B with paired walk-bootstrap intervals.
